servicesPage.title: Our Services
servicesPage.intro: Sameday Express offers a comprehensive range of logistics services designed to meet your urgent delivery needs. From same-day delivery to specialized medical transport, we have the expertise and fleet to handle it all.

sameDay.title: Same Day Delivery
sameDay.description: Our flagship service ensures your packages reach their destination within hours. With direct, non-stop transport and real-time tracking, you can trust us with your most time-sensitive deliveries.

aog.title: AOG — Aircraft on Ground
aog.description: When an aircraft is grounded, every minute counts. Our AOG service operates 24/7 to deliver critical aviation parts to get planes back in the air. We understand the urgency and have dedicated teams ready to respond immediately.

bioscience.title: Bioscience & Testing
bioscience.description: We specialize in transporting lab samples, test kits, and biological materials with the utmost care. Our drivers are trained in handling sensitive materials and maintaining proper chain of custody.

medical.title: Medical Courier
medical.description: Temperature-sensitive medications, hospital supplies, and healthcare logistics require specialized handling. Our medical courier service ensures compliance with all healthcare regulations while delivering on time.

crossBorder.title: Cross-Border Transport
crossBorder.description: Canada–USA express shipping with full customs compliance. We handle all the paperwork and regulatory requirements to ensure smooth cross-border deliveries.

warehousing.title: Warehousing & Fulfillment
warehousing.description: Complete storage, pick-and-pack, and last-mile delivery solutions for e-commerce businesses. Scale your operations with our flexible warehousing services.

zonesPage.intro: Sameday Express provides comprehensive coverage across major Canadian provinces and cross-border services to the United States. Our extensive network ensures reliable delivery wherever your business takes you.
